# Which role can use which MCP tool

<!-- Generated together with mcp-tool-roles.json; do not edit by hand. -->

An agent has the access of the user it acts for. This page shows what that gives on each role a new
workspace starts with. [rbac-matrix.md](rbac-matrix.md) lists the grants themselves;
[agent-tools.md](agent-tools.md) lists the tools.

Nobody types this page. It is drawn from [mcp-tool-roles.json](mcp-tool-roles.json), and the test that
writes the file fails when the answers change and the file does not. The file's note says how it is
measured:

> Generated by TestTheToolRoleMatrixIsPublished (backend/internal/compose/integration). A passport on each seeded role calls every tool and action once. Each record a call names is a new one the role's user owns, made through the app's own routes; a kind the sweep cannot make is a placeholder id that names no record. A refusal counts only where the admin passes the same call. Each role whose row scope is narrower than all then calls every tool that takes a company, contact, deal, lead or project on one a colleague owns. Do not edit by hand.

| Mark | Meaning |
|---|---|
| ✓ | The call ran for this role. |
| ✗ | A gate refused this role. |
| ? | Not proven either way. The call stopped first; [why it stopped](#why-a-call-stopped) counts the reasons. |

A cell with counts, such as `5✓ 2✗ 3?`, covers the actions of one router. Row scope, the seat and the passport's
scopes still apply to each call. A ✓ says the role passed on a record it owns;
[a colleague's record](#a-colleagues-record) shows what the narrower roles get on one they do not own.

Regenerate from the repository root, then from `backend/`:

    UPDATE_MCP_TOOL_ROLES=1 make test-it DIR=backend/internal/compose/integration RUN=TestTheToolRoleMatrixIsPublished
    go test ./internal/compose/ -run TestTheToolRolePageIsTheMatrix -update-mcp-tool-roles-page

## Why a call stopped

A cell is proven only where the admin passes the same call, so the admin column is the work left.

| Reason | Meaning | admin | Every role |
|---|---|---|---|
| `conflict` | The record is not in the state the call needs. | 5 | 26 |
| `internal` | The server failed, or answered 503 for a service the test stack does not start. | 9 | 51 |
| `not_found` | No such record: a kind the sweep does not seed, or a record it does not relate. | 82 | 405 |
| `other` | Any other answer. | 2 | 6 |
| `refused` | The admin was refused too, so the refusal is about the record, not the role. | 6 | 36 |
| `unsupported` | The installation does not offer the service the call needs. | 15 | 90 |
| `validation` | An argument was refused: a value the filler cannot make. | 52 | 280 |

## A colleague's record

Each role below reads fewer rows than all. Every granted seat reads a company, contact, deal, lead or project, so a call may run; the test fails when one changes the colleague's record: its version, update time, archive or owner.
